A Switch Expression Is a Value, So Every Arm Must Produce One
An Arrow Label Runs One Arm and Never Falls Through; a Colon Label Still Does, Even in an Expression

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-statement-assigns-label: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-statement-assigns-label: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-statement-assigns-label: Section 'A Switch Expression Is a Value, So Every Arm Must Produce One': the statement assigning n in an arm for each of the four Plan constants gives 'error: variable n might not have been initialized', and 'The compiler doesn't treat a statement over an enum as complete, because a statement may skip a constant and run nothing.' This decides c directly.
recorded.prompt:q-number-from-switch: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-number-from-switch: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-number-from-switch: Section 1: `Object sw = switch (k) { case 0 -> 1; default -> 2.0; };` prints 'switch:  1 (Integer)', and 'Assigned to Object, the switch takes the target type, and each arm is boxed on its own.' The Summary generalizes this: 'assigned to a reference type it boxes each arm on its own rather than promoting like ?:'. The page shows it only for Object. Number is covered only through the Summary's 'reference type' wording.
recorded.prompt:q-island-fee: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-island-fee: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-island-fee: Section 'An Arrow Label Runs One Arm and Never Falls Through; a Colon Label Still Does, Even in an Expression': the colon-label example gives 'colon TEAM seats: 50 [team discount applied]', and '`TEAM` has no `yield`, so it falls into `BUSINESS` and returns 50.' The quiz has the same structure (ISLAND->REMOTE), so this decides a.
recorded.prompt:q-new-region-old-build: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-region-old-build: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-new-region-old-build: Section 'A Constant Added After Compilation Reaches the Switch as MatchException': the output shows 'noDefault(EDUCATION) threw java.lang.MatchException', and 'For a switch expression over an enum with no default, javac adds one of its own that throws.' The callout says that for --release 20 or lower it is IncompatibleClassChangeError instead, which matches the stem's --release 21. The Summary also says '... throws MatchException in a switch expression with no default compiled for release 21, from the default javac generated.'

recorded.prompt:q-statement-assigns-label:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-statement-assigns-label:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-statement-assigns-label:a: Refuted directly by the same example. Every constant has an assigning arm, yet javac reports 'variable n might not have been initialized'.
recorded.prompt:q-statement-assigns-label:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-statement-assigns-label:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-statement-assigns-label:b: Refuted directly. The failing statement example uses arrow labels (case FREE -> n = 1;) and still does not compile. Section 2 also says 'The arrow ... and the expression form arrived together in Java 14, but they are independent.'
recorded.prompt:q-statement-assigns-label:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-statement-assigns-label:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-statement-assigns-label:d: Refuted directly. The page's own statement example has assignments in its arrow arms, and the error is about initialization, not the assignment. The Reference 'Arm forms' table says that for `case A, B -> e;` in a statement, 'e must be a statement (call, assignment)'.
recorded.prompt:q-number-from-switch:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-number-from-switch:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-number-from-switch:b: Refuted directly by the var case: `var v = switch (k) { case 0 -> 1; default -> 2.0; };` gives '1.0 (Double)', and the page says 'var gives the switch none [no target type], so ... the int is promoted to double.' Partly true: the answer 'true' is correct, but the reason ('whatever type the other arms have') is wrong.
recorded.prompt:q-number-from-switch:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-number-from-switch:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-number-from-switch:c: Refuted directly. The ternary gives 1.0 (Double), but the switch assigned to Object gives 1 (Integer). 'A ?: whose operands are both numeric ignores its target', which is contrasted with the switch that takes its target type.
recorded.prompt:q-number-from-switch:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-number-from-switch:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-number-from-switch:d: Refuted directly. A mixed switch assigned to Object gives Integer. Promotion happens only under var ('var gives the switch none').
recorded.prompt:q-island-fee:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-island-fee:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-island-fee:b: Refuted directly. In the page's identical structure, TEAM falls into the next case BUSINESS and returns 50, not default's 1000.
recorded.prompt:q-island-fee:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-island-fee:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-island-fee:c: Refuted directly. The page's TEAM case has no yield, yet the switch compiles and runs, giving 50. The Summary says 'A colon case without yield runs into the next case.'
recorded.prompt:q-island-fee:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-island-fee:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-island-fee:d: Refuted directly: 'A switch expression can still use colon labels, ending each case with yield.' Also: 'Mixing arrows and colons in one switch is a compile error: different case kinds used in the switch.'
recorded.prompt:q-new-region-old-build:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-region-old-build:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-new-region-old-build:b: Refuted by the shown output (MatchException, not NPE). The page names NullPointerException only for a null selector in Reference: 'A null selector throws NullPointerException unless the switch has case null'. The page never says outright that an NPE does not come from an unmatched constant, so this is partly by implication.
recorded.prompt:q-new-region-old-build:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-region-old-build:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-new-region-old-build:c: Refuted directly: 'the switch fails at the line that needs a decision instead of picking an arm.' The output shows a throw, not a returned value.
recorded.prompt:q-new-region-old-build:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-new-region-old-build:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-new-region-old-build:d: Refuted directly by the MatchException output and 'An expression must finish with a value'. Section 1 says every arm yields or throws. That no null is returned follows by implication from the throw.
